invariants.rationale: This directly reflects the implemented computation in the method, relating the return value to the product of quantity and unit price.
If getQuantity() and getUnitPrice() both return non-negative values, the price should never be negative.
The method would throw a NullPointerException before returning if order were null, so this holds at method exit.
If the order's quantity and unit price cannot be negative, result is always non-negative.
